instruction: A rounded cup of bubble tea with a big smiley blush face, a domed lid, and a fat striped straw poking out the top. Pastel milk-tea gradients fill the cup while chubby dark tapioca pearls with sparkle-eyes settle at the bottom, all in adorable super-cute proportions.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE Kawaii Boba Tea in a kawaii style. Pastel milk-tea gradients fill the cup while chubby dark tapioca pearls with sparkle-eyes settle at the bottom, all in adorable super-cute proportions.
